=== Libertalia: Shared Hand ===

Three pirates each start with 0 doubloons. The game has 2 campaigns of 5 days (10 days in all). At the start of each campaign every player receives the same 7-card hand: ranks 1 to 7, one card of each rank. Cards played are removed from the owner's hand. The 2 cards left after day 5 are discarded unused, and a fresh full hand is dealt for campaign 2. Which cards each player has played is public once revealed.

CHARACTERS:
- Rank 1, Cabin Boy: takes no booty. Gains 3 doubloons.
- Rank 2, Gunner: takes booty normally. Every other non-clashed player who played rank 6 or 7 loses 3 doubloons.
- Rank 3, Quartermaster: takes booty normally. Gains 1 doubloon for each other non-clashed player who played a higher rank.
- Rank 4, Bosun: takes booty normally. If the token taken is negative, it counts as 0; otherwise it counts at face value.
- Rank 5, Merchant: takes booty normally. Gains 2 extra doubloons if the token taken is worth 3 or more; otherwise no extra.
- Rank 6, Captain: takes booty normally. No ability.
- Rank 7, Admiral: takes booty normally. Pays a wage: loses 2 doubloons.

BOOTY ROWS: each day one row is drawn at random, each of the 6 equally likely, with replacement, from: A [5,3,1], B [5,1,-3], C [3,3,1], D [5,3,-3], E [3,1,-3], F [5,5,-3]. The values are the 3 tokens, listed best to worst.

EACH DAY:
1. Draw the booty row and announce it to all players.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages are not binding.
3. All players secretly and simultaneously choose one card from their hand.
4. Reveal all cards.
5. Clash: if two or three players played the same rank, all of those players are clashed. They take no booty, their abilities do not fire, and their cards are still spent. A player whose rank nobody else played is not clashed and plays normally.
6. Booty: non-clashed players other than the Cabin Boy are ordered by rank, highest first. The first takes the best token, the second the next, and so on. Tokens left over are discarded.
7. Abilities of non-clashed characters resolve at the same time, as listed above. Gunner and Quartermaster count only non-clashed players.
8. Each player adds their token value plus or minus their ability effects to their score.
9. After day 5, discard leftover cards and deal fresh hands. After day 10, the game ends.

The Cabin Boy's +3 still applies when other players take booty. Scores can go negative.

After 10 days, the player with the highest doubloon total wins. If two or more players share the highest total, they share the win.

=== Libertalia: Shared Hand ===

Three pirates each start with 0 doubloons. The game has 2 campaigns of 5 days (10 days in all). At the start of each campaign every player receives the same 7-card hand: ranks 1 to 7, one card of each rank. Cards played are removed from the owner's hand. The 2 cards left after day 5 are discarded unused, and a fresh full hand is dealt for campaign 2. Which cards each player has played is public once revealed.

CHARACTERS:
- Rank 1, Cabin Boy: takes no booty. Gains 3 doubloons.
- Rank 2, Gunner: takes booty normally. Every other non-clashed player who played rank 6 or 7 loses 3 doubloons.
- Rank 3, Quartermaster: takes booty normally. Gains 1 doubloon for each other non-clashed player who played a higher rank.
- Rank 4, Bosun: takes booty normally. If the token taken is negative, it counts as 0; otherwise it counts at face value.
- Rank 5, Merchant: takes booty normally. Gains 2 extra doubloons if the token taken is worth 3 or more; otherwise no extra.
- Rank 6, Captain: takes booty normally. No ability.
- Rank 7, Admiral: takes booty normally. Pays a wage: loses 2 doubloons.

BOOTY ROWS: each day one row is drawn at random, each of the 6 equally likely, with replacement, from: A [5,3,1], B [5,1,-3], C [3,3,1], D [5,3,-3], E [3,1,-3], F [5,5,-3]. The values are the 3 tokens, listed best to worst.

EACH DAY:
1. Draw the booty row and announce it to all players.
2. Talk: everyone writes one short message at the same time. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages are not binding.
3. All players secretly and simultaneously choose one card from their hand.
4. Reveal all cards.
5. Clash: if two or three players played the same rank, all of those players are clashed. They take no booty, their abilities do not fire, and their cards are still spent. A player whose rank nobody else played is not clashed and plays normally.
6. Booty: non-clashed players other than the Cabin Boy are ordered by rank, highest first. The first takes the best token, the second the next, and so on. Tokens left over are discarded.
7. Abilities of non-clashed characters resolve at the same time, as listed above. Gunner and Quartermaster count only non-clashed players.
8. Each player adds their token value plus or minus their ability effects to their score.
9. After day 5, discard leftover cards and deal fresh hands. After day 10, the game ends.

The Cabin Boy's +3 still applies when other players take booty. Scores can go negative.

After 10 days, the player with the highest doubloon total wins. If two or more players share the highest total, they share the win.

- Rank 1, Cabin Boy: takes no booty. Gains 3 doubloons.
- Rank 2, Gunner: takes booty normally. Every other non-clashed player who played rank 6 or 7 loses 3 doubloons.
- Rank 3, Quartermaster: takes booty normally. Gains 1 doubloon for each other non-clashed player who played a higher rank.
- Rank 4, Bosun: takes booty normally. If the token taken is negative, it counts as 0; otherwise it counts at face value.
- Rank 5, Merchant: takes booty normally. Gains 2 extra doubloons if the token taken is worth 3 or more; otherwise no extra.

3. All players secretly and simultaneously choose one card from their hand.
